text: Juno Dawson's This Book Is Gay was challenged in Wasilla, Alaska, after a boy picked it up from the juvenile non-fiction shelf of the public library, in a report dated 26 Nov 2015. In a survey reported on 19 Aug 2024, Index on Censorship said 53% of librarians polled had been asked to remove books, and This Book Is Gay was among the titles complained about.
meta_description: Juno Dawson's This Book Is Gay was challenged at the Wasilla, Alaska public library in 2015 and named in a 2024 Index on Censorship survey of removal requests.
